headline: Nine Vicious says he barely knows Young Thug and has only met him twice, despite his past
body: Nine Vicious says he barely knows Young Thug and has only met him twice, despite his past ties to YSL Records. “I’ma be honest I don’t really know Young Thug…,” he said on Oct. 16.
